st0x-liquidity-client --env production debug position set <symbol> --target-net <N> [--price-usdc <USDC_PER_SHARE>] --reason "<reason>"
st0x-liquidity-client --env production debug position set MSTR --target-net <N> [--price-usdc <USDC_PER_SHARE>] --reason "<reason>"
